cards.claim: The authors propose the Transformer, a model architecture that relies entirely on attention mechanisms and eschews recurrence.
cards.evidence_quote: In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.

cards.claim: The Transformer allows for significantly more parallelization compared to recurrent models.
cards.evidence_quote: The Transformer allows for significantly more parallelization and can reach a new state of the art in translation quality after being trained for as little as twelve hours on eight P100 GPUs.

cards.claim: Recurrent models inherently preclude parallelization within training examples due to their sequential nature.
cards.evidence_quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths

cards.claim: The Transformer reaches a new state of the art in translation quality after being trained for as little as twelve hours on eight P100 GPUs.
cards.evidence_quote: can reach a new state of the art in translation quality after being trained for as little as twelve hours on eight P100 GPUs.

cards.claim: The Transformer reduces the number of operations to relate distant positions to a constant, unlike convolutional models where complexity grows with distance.
cards.evidence_quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations

cards.claim: The authors claim the Transformer is the first transduction model that relies entirely on self-attention without using RNNs or convolutions.
cards.evidence_quote: the Transformer is the first transduction model relying entirely on self-attention

cards.claim: Self-attention relates different positions of a single sequence to compute a representation of that sequence.
cards.evidence_quote: Self-attention... is an attention mechanism relating different positions of a single sequence

cards.claim: The Transformer model utilizes a stacked self-attention and point-wise fully connected layer architecture for both its encoder and decoder components.
cards.evidence_quote: The Transformer follows this overall architecture using stacked self-attention and point-wise, fully connected layers for both the encoder and decoder

cards.claim: The encoder consists of a stack of six identical layers, each containing multi-head self-attention and a position-wise feed-forward network with residual connections.
cards.evidence_quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of N = 6 identical layers. Each layer has two sub-layers. The first is a multi-head self-attention mechanism

cards.claim: Multi-head attention allows the model to attend to information from different representation subspaces simultaneously using eight parallel attention layers.
cards.evidence_quote: Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions

cards.claim: The proposed model relies entirely on attention mechanisms, discarding recurrence and convolution to process sequential data.
cards.evidence_quote: Since our model contains no recurrence and no convolution, in order for the model to make use of the order of the sequence...

cards.claim: The encoder utilizes self-attention layers where keys, values, and queries originate from the previous layer's output.
cards.evidence_quote: In a self-attention layer all of the keys, values and queries come from the same place, in this case, the output of the previous layer

cards.claim: Decoder self-attention is masked to prevent leftward information flow, preserving the auto-regressive property required for sequence generation.
cards.evidence_quote: We need to prevent leftward information flow in the decoder to preserve the auto-regressive property. We implement this ... by masking out

cards.claim: Position-wise feed-forward networks are applied identically to each position, consisting of two linear transformations with a ReLU activation.
cards.evidence_quote: This consists of two linear transformations with a ReLU activation in between. FFN(x) = max(0, xW1 + b1)W2 + b2

cards.claim: Self-attention layers connect all positions with a constant number of sequential operations, whereas recurrent layers require O(n) sequential operations.
cards.evidence_quote: a self-attention layer connects all positions with a constant number of sequentially executed operations, whereas a recurrent layer requires O(n) sequential operations

cards.claim: Self-attention layers are faster than recurrent layers when the sequence length n is smaller than the representation dimensionality d.
cards.evidence_quote: self-attention layers are faster than recurrent layers when the sequence length n is smaller than the representation dimensionality d

cards.claim: The shortest path between any input and output positions makes it easier to learn long-range dependencies.
cards.evidence_quote: The shorter these paths between any combination of positions in the input and output sequences, the easier it is to learn long-range dependencies

cards.claim: Self-attention can yield more interpretable models by exhibiting behavior related to syntactic and semantic structure.
cards.evidence_quote: self-attention could yield more interpretable models. We inspect attention distributions from our models

cards.claim: The Transformer (big) model achieved state-of-the-art results with a BLEU score of 28.4 on English-to-German translation.
cards.evidence_quote: Transformer (big) 28.4

cards.claim: The Transformer (base model) achieved a BLEU score of 38.1 on the English-to-French newstest2014 test set.
cards.evidence_quote: Transformer (base model) 27.3 38.1

cards.claim: The models were trained using the Adam optimizer with specific beta values and a learning rate schedule involving linear warmup.
cards.evidence_quote: We used the Adam optimizer [20] with β1 = 0.9, β2 = 0.98

cards.claim: Label smoothing was employed during training to improve accuracy and BLEU score despite hurting perplexity.
cards.evidence_quote: This hurts perplexity, as the model learns to be more unsure, but improves accuracy and BLEU score.

cards.claim: The big Transformer model achieves a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of 28.4 on WMT 2014 English-to-German translation, outperforming previous best models by more than 2.0 BLEU.
cards.evidence_quote: establishing a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of 28.4

cards.claim: On WMT 2014 English-to-French translation, the big Transformer model achieves a BLEU score of 41.0, outperforming all previously published single models.
cards.evidence_quote: our big model achieves a BLEU score of 41.0, outperforming all of the previously published single models

cards.claim: The Transformer model generalizes well to English constituency parsing, achieving an F1 score of 92.7 in a semi-supervised setting.
cards.evidence_quote: Transformer (4 layers) semi-supervised 92.7

cards.claim: Reducing the attention key size dk hurts model quality, suggesting that determining compatibility is difficult and a more sophisticated function than dot product may be beneficial.
cards.evidence_quote: reducing the attention key size dk hurts model quality. This suggests that determining compatibility is not easy

cards.claim: The Transformer model achieves superior performance compared to all previously reported models except for the Recurrent Neural Network Grammar.
cards.evidence_quote: yielding better results than all previously reported models with the exception of the Recurrent Neural Network Grammar [8].

cards.claim: The Transformer outperforms the Berkeley-Parser even when trained on a small dataset of 40K sentences.
cards.evidence_quote: the Transformer outperforms the Berkeley-Parser [29] even when training only on the WSJ training set of 40K sentences.

cards.claim: The Transformer is the first sequence transduction model based entirely on attention, replacing recurrent layers with multi-headed self-attention.
cards.evidence_quote: we presented the Transformer, the first sequence transduction model based entirely on attention, replacing the recurrent layers most commonly used in encoder-decoder architectures with multi-headed self-attention.

cards.claim: The Transformer achieves new state-of-the-art results on WMT 2014 English-to-German and English-to-French translation tasks.
cards.evidence_quote: On both WMT 2014 English-to-German and WMT 2014 English-to-French translation tasks, we achieve a new state of the art.

cards.claim: The Transformer can be trained significantly faster than architectures based on recurrent or convolutional layers.
cards.evidence_quote: For translation tasks, the Transformer can be trained significantly faster than architectures based on recurrent or convolutional layers.

cards.claim: Future work includes extending the Transformer to other modalities like images and audio, investigating local attention mechanisms, and making generation less sequential.
cards.evidence_quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms

rejected.claim: Scaled Dot-Product Attention divides dot products by the square root of the key dimension to prevent large values from pushing the softmax into regions with small gradients.
rejected.evidence_quote: To counteract this effect, we scale the dot products by 1 / sqrt(dk)
